sections_en.text: This document outlines the half-yearly maintenance steps I2, M6, for the make-up pump, which is the pump responsible for maintaining the water pressure inside the fire-fighting lines at 8.5 bar; there are 2 pumps.

The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Abdel Meguid El-Henawy, reviewed by Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader and Eng. Hossam El-Rify, accepted by Eng. Magdy Okba, General Manager of Boiler Maintenance, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of El-Nubaria Power Station Sector.

The document was reviewed and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality Control at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's Maintenance Procedure Information System coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.

items: Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment.
Those carrying out the maintenance work must hold an occupational safety and health category card.
Cordon off the area to define the work area, and place warning signs.
Wear personal protective equipment ( safety helmet, safety shoes , overalls , gloves ..... ).
Isolate the pump electrically and mechanically.
Close the suction and discharge valves.

Pump-specific tools, 
 suitable lifting device for the pump

Inspect any leaks from the suction and discharge valves.
Make sure there are no vibrations on the pump, and check the fastening of the main bolts.
Make sure the motor shaft is aligned with the pump shaft.
Make sure the batteries are sound.
Make sure of the level and temperature of the cooling water.
Check the cleanliness of the fuel filters.
Make sure the suction and discharge pipes and valves are sound.

Introduction
This document outlines the half-yearly maintenance steps I2, M6, for the make-up pump, which is the pump responsible for maintaining the water pressure inside the fire-fighting lines at 8.5 bar; there are 2 pumps.
Technical specifications:
3 | : | Number of stages

3.7 | : | NPSH
590 cubic metres per 
 second | : | Flow

9.8 bar | : | Water discharge pressure
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Abdel Meguid El-Henawy, reviewed by Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader and Eng. Hossam El-Rify, accepted by Eng. Magdy Okba, General Manager of Boiler Maintenance, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of El-Nubaria Power Station Sector.
The document was reviewed and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality Control at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's Maintenance Procedure Information System coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment.
Those carrying out the maintenance work must hold an occupational safety and health category card.
Cordon off the area to define the work area, and place warning signs.
Wear personal protective equipment ( safety helmet, safety shoes , overalls , gloves ..... ).
Isolate the pump electrically and mechanically.
Close the suction and discharge valves.
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Complete tool bag
Pump-specific tools, 
 suitable lifting device for the pump
Cleaning fluid, rags, 
 Straight edge
Procedures to be Carried Out
1. | Inspect the 
 Pressure Indicator
 on the 
 Fire line.
2. | Check the pressure from the 
 Display 
on the pump.
3. | Inspect the alarms from the auxiliary control panel and the main control panel.
4. | Test the 
 Pressure Switch
 inside the pump control panel 
 if necessary.
5. | Inspect any leaks from the suction and discharge valves.
6. | Make sure there are no vibrations on the pump, and check the fastening of the main bolts.
7. | Make sure the motor shaft is aligned with the pump shaft.
8. | Make sure the batteries are sound.
9. | Make sure of the level and temperature of the cooling water.
10. | Measure the oil level.
11. | Check the cleanliness of the fuel filters.
12. | Make sure the suction and discharge pipes and valves are sound.
